data.name: Axiom
data.description: Axiom's API lets agents ingest and query machine data and manage observability resources. Its hosted MCP server exposes query, monitor, notifier, and dashboard tools.

data.name: DeepWiki
data.description: DeepWiki's public MCP server lets agents inspect a repository's wiki structure, read generated documentation, and ask questions grounded in a codebase.

data.name: Exa
data.description: Exa gives agents web search and page contents through its Search API, structured collection building through Websets, and live search tools through a hosted MCP server.

data.name: Figma
data.description: Figma's REST API lets agents inspect files, comments, components, variables, projects, and webhooks. Its hosted MCP server supplies authenticated design context and canvas tools.

data.name: GitHub
data.description: GitHub exposes more agent-callable surface area than almost any service: an official remote MCP server, a fully-specified REST API, a GraphQL API, and the `gh` CLI. Pick the format that fits your agent — they all reach the same data.

auth.note: OAuth in supporting clients, or a PAT bearer header anywhere else.

data.name: Linear
data.description: Linear's entire product runs on its public GraphQL API, and its hosted MCP server gives agents the same tools the official integrations use: create and update issues, manage projects, and coordinate cycles.

data.name: Notion
data.description: Notion's hosted MCP server lets agents search, create, and reorganize workspace content. The REST API underneath uses internal integrations with explicit page-level sharing — a natural permission boundary for agents.

data.name: PostHog
data.description: PostHog's MCP server exposes 50+ tools: run HogQL, build insights and dashboards, manage feature flags. Agents can answer 'what changed in signups last week?' against real product data.

data.name: Resend
data.description: Resend is an email API built for developers. The official MCP server exposes sending, contacts, audiences, broadcasts, and domain management; the REST API is small enough for an agent to learn in one read.

data.name: Sentry
data.description: Sentry's hosted MCP server gives agents direct access to issues, events, releases, and Seer root-cause runs — the context a coding agent needs to fix what's actually broken in production.

data.name: Stripe
data.description: Stripe ships an official MCP server with documentation search and account tools, a meticulously specified REST API, and the Stripe CLI. Restricted API keys make it one of the safest services to hand to an autonomous agent.

auth.note: OAuth in supporting clients; restricted-key bearer header for autonomous agents. Local stdio alternative: npx -y @stripe/mcp@latest

data.name: Miro

data.name: Cloudflare Developer Platform
data.description: Enables users to build applications on Cloudflare Workers using built-in storage, AI, and compute primitives. Deploy code to production, create and query databases, manage KV stores, and more.

data.name: aside.com
data.description: Aside is an AI browser that performs tasks across websites, accounts, browsing history, and files. Its help center documents browser features, AI-provider configuration, account use, and local developer tools.

data.name: AniList

auth.note: Public queries work unauthenticated, while all mutations and access to private user data require an OAuth access token.
